text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin Daishoten turned into a fierce 
race. Sakura Laurel suffered a defeat. 
However, the high-level battle thoroughly 
thrilled the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
alongside Narita Brian." With such talk 
arising, Sakura Laurel too lets her 
imagination wander to that dream 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, news arrived that Narita Brian 
had suffered an injury and would skip the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). Even so, Sakura Laurel 
kept her eyes fixed straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She would run races and attain strength 
just like Narita Brian. To that end, she 
aimed for the Tenno Sho (Spring) as 
planned.
